steps.name: IF you want a fairy ring in your house keep in mind that you will be unlocking a lot of slayer monster by doing priest in peril so not recommended to this this b4 slayer
Spectransfering yourself with slayer can be a really efficient way to get a lot of melee xp while still getting good slayer xp/h. ideally you want to have 2 xfer alts
you need 91 magic for energy transfer but 92 for heal other, so you want have 92 on atleast 1 alt

having 82 con to boost for an ornate pool in your poh would be ideal but you can also get the Revitalisation pool and just bring food to heal yourself again on the alt (you only have to cast heal other a couple times per task)
You want to set up your house in a certain way so it loads in 2ticks. No upper or lower floors. like this: https://i.imgur.com/jrxJq0F.png and https://i.imgur.com/cYvdolY.png
Splashing (takes very long but is cheap)
burst jellies/dusts in catacombs (Desert treasure required)
Burst in MM1 caves
String jewelry (after 80 magic)
get 82-83 con and boost with stew and crystal saw to 90
build ornate pool
build portal nexus and portal room (1t faster compared to portal)
unlock kourend caste teleport
put kourend teleport in nexus and lunar in portal room
get 65 construction and boost with stew and saw to 70
build Revitalisation pool (only spec and run)
build portal room
unlock kourend caste teleport
put kourend teleport and lunar in portal room
